title: Race condition in invitation methods: concurrent modification without lock
description: groups_collection.py: record_invitation (lines 467-487) and consume_invitation (lines 496-507) modify invitations and consumed_invitations dicts without _mutation_lock. rekey() modifies these same structures under the lock at lines 357-373. Result: invitation state corruption or lost burn markers, potentially allowing revoked enrollments to resurrect.
close_reason: record_invitation and consume_invitation now mutate under _mutation_lock (private _consume_invitation_unlocked helper + locked public wrapper, mirroring rekey). Probed lock-held during mutation; cross-thread rekey interleaving tests prove no lost burn markers. tests/coap 1752 passed; ruff check+format clean on touched hunks.
